definitions.title: The Natural Logarithm as an Integral
definitions.statement: The natural logarithm function ln(x) is defined for all x > 0 as the accumulated area under the hyperbola y = 1/t from t = 1 to t = x.
definitions.explanation: By FTC Part 1, d/dx[ln(x)] = 1/x for all x > 0.
definitions.keyTakeaway: ln(x) fills the gap in the power rule int t^(-1) dt.

definitions.title: Logarithmic Differentiation
definitions.statement: Technique that simplifies products, quotients, and variable exponents by taking the natural logarithm before differentiating.
definitions.explanation: Logarithms convert products into sums and exponents into coefficients.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Essential for differentiating variable-base and variable-exponent functions u(x)^v(x).
